description: Delete an actor's account with a token and password (AT Protocol standard). Extension: a pseudonym omits password and token and sends a Bearer JWT signed by its owner key (lxm = this method, iss = did, at most 5 minutes). Allowed for an active account, or a deactivated copy whose DID now names another server; refused for a deactivated account the DID still names here, and for suspended or taken-down accounts.

main.description: Delete an actor's account with a token and password (AT Protocol standard). Extension: a pseudonym omits password and token and sends a Bearer JWT signed by its owner key (lxm = this method, iss = did, at most 5 minutes). Allowed for an active account, or a deactivated copy whose DID now names another server; refused for a deactivated account the DID still names here, and for suspended or taken-down accounts.

token.description: The code from requestAccountDelete. Required for user accounts.

errors.name: InvalidToken
errors.description: The code (or the pseudonym's proof) is invalid, expired or already used.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Missing fields, or the account cannot be deleted in its state.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: A pseudonym's owner-key proof is missing.

errors.name: AccountDeactivated
errors.description: Deactivated while the DID still names this server: reactivate first.

errors.name: AccountModerated
errors.description: Suspended or taken down: only moderation can remove it.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: The PLC directory could not be reached.
